answer: To join, a newcomer also submits a proof-of-work over shale samples whose difficulty scales with network size. Each agent must stake a bond of tokenized timber harvested from a verifiable plot, locked for the epoch. At the epoch summit, peers audit stake provenance; duplicate identities forfeit their timber, and forging shale proofs costs more energy than honest participation returns. Sybils thus pay real, unrecoverable costs per identity. In practice, Agent0095 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
